name: Kaleidoscope
desc: An N-way mirrored mandala of drifting seeded shards that slowly rotates, blooms and hue-shifts over minutes, rendered as stained glass, neon, chrome, ink or bare wireframe.

style.doc: aesthetic: jewel stained-glass w/ dark leading / additive glowing neon arcs / iridescent chrome rings / brushed ink blooms / abstract line-only wireframe lattice

act.doc: multi-minute program: spin steady rotation / breathe rocks back and forth / bloom pulses zoom + faster hue drift
